sourceLocation.storagePolicy: verbatim attributed scientific reference; never overwritten by normalization

audit.invalidWavelengthPolicy: The default source-recorded reference preserves 380-730 nm exactly as accepted by the user; an independently reported 440-700 nm sensitivity path exposes the source author's invalid-<440-nm warning and the instrument's upper-range concern.

txtCrossCheck.expectedComposition: 32 Greyscale readings followed by 5 Summary readings

normalizationPolicy.spectraAccess: read verbatim from the pinned ODS for every rebuild
normalizationPolicy.exactCountSeries: reading n maps to RGB555 code n-1
normalizationPolicy.rAndGCountMismatch: No missing/extra code identity is invented. Ordered readings are placed on a uniform source-index axis spanning code 0 through 31 and resampled only in the derived model.
normalizationPolicy.monotonicRepair: Raw and integrated readings remain unchanged here; any monotonic projection is a separately reported color-model transform.
normalizationPolicy.blackPolicy: All per-series black readings and the dedicated Summary black remain separate facts.

d65Integration.method: linearly interpolate the source 10 nm reflectance to the verbatim CIE 1 nm grid, multiply by CIE D65 and CIE 1931 2 degree CMFs, and normalize Y over the same declared wavelength range
d65Integration.classification: derived directly from verbatim measurements and verbatim CIE standard tables

upstreamD65Fixture.classification: upstream-derived comparison; not the project reference model
